title: The ARUNACHAL PRADESH UNIVERSITY ACT, 2012
full_text: The ARUNACHAL PRADESH UNIVERSITY ACT, 2012 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20125 Act Number: 5 Enactment Date: 2012-04-08 Act Year: 2012 Short Title: The ARUNACHAL PRADESH UNIVERSITY ACT, 2012 Long Title: to establish and incorporate a teaching and affiliating University for the State of Arunachal Pradesh.
